verification.scope: Static source-extraction and selected CAD-provider wrapper corroboration. No native execution or live binding. Analyzer-listed instruction starts are not complete-function coverage; indirect provider contracts remain unresolved.

selectionRules: Line source picks are Float32 XYZ promoted to double for distance arithmetic; the point extractors have no equivalent pick input.
Additional point-source candidates are traversed in increasing record order, transformed, and replaced only by strictly smaller squared distance; ties retain the first candidate.
Additional axis and plane candidates are traversed in outer then inner array order; candidate projection uses helper 0x14027d8c0 before eligibility extraction.
Initial best squared distance is 3.4028234663852886e38; equal or greater candidate distance does not replace the best.
Axis and plane candidate admission rejects NaN returned X and checks a Float32 sentinel-distance expression with threshold 2^-23 before distance comparison.
Axis conversion chooses the nearest candidate first, then tests eligibility with 0x14027e4e0 and extracts with 0x14027eb60. Failure does not retry the next-nearest candidate.

Plane conversion chooses first, extracts with 0x14049cc00, and accepts only abs(sqrt((ny*ny + nx*nx) + nz*nz) - 1) < 2^-23. Equality rejects; no renormalization or next-candidate retry occurs at this caller.

providerBoundary.nearestProjection: 0x14027d8c0 calls imported provider functions, scales input/output through runtime globals, and accepts status zero with positive result count and first result code 0x475e. Later auxiliary parameter/derivative lookup failure does not invalidate accepted position. It initializes a one-byte flag and releases the result allocation.
providerBoundary.axisEligibility: 0x14027e4e0 returns a Boolean in AL despite the decompiler void signature. With the alternate provider flag set it tries 0x14026adf0 then 0x14026afc0. The pointer-based path admits exactly classification codes 1, 2, 4 and 7; these codes do not establish CAD type names.
providerBoundary.axisExtraction: 0x14027eb60 returns Boolean. Pointer-based classes 1/2 compute parameter endpoints and their distance; classes 4/7 normalize the supplied direction and write extent 1. The alternate provider path writes origin/direction without a visible extent-output write. Its caller ignores the return Boolean and reads the reused scratch as a double; a deterministic extent is not established.
providerBoundary.planeExtraction: 0x14049cc00 zeroes twelve output doubles. The alternate provider with a nonzero handle delegates to 0x14026aaa0; otherwise the pointer-based path requires classification zero and constructs a frame from evaluated surface derivatives and three parameter-corner samples. Exact provider semantics remain open.

staticAudit.finding: Alternate-provider axis extent output is not visibly initialized; retain as an unresolved path rather than supplying an invented length.

pointRetainedFieldInvestigation.scope: Narrow linear decode of 45 observed point-object/dialog unwind ranges found one candidate write to 0x2c4. This does not establish that retained fields are unused or recover their semantics.

mcpCoverage: No application behavior or discovery changed. Future source resolution must be shared by GUI and MCP and expose precise retained picks, source order, source identity and extraction diagnostics.
